review_method: Actually viewed all101 fresh native480x854 PNGs using tools.view_image across each of the26 original-resolution2x2 call sheets(call-01.png through call-26.png). Every quadrant was inspected;25 sheets contain4 frames and the last contains1. Individually viewed the original emerald-light-normal-largefont and frost-dark-normal-longname-en PNGs to confirm the two bounded text patterns. Recomputed every original PNG SHA-256, checked exact source/tree/run provenance and verified each sheet crop equals the corresponding original PNG pixel bytes. This is visual inspection of this call group only, not a claim of native call action or physical audio validation.

bounded_findings.finding: All20 long-name cases ellipsize the caller name to fit the identity area. Truncation is stronger in the frost/ivory side-avatar normal layouts. The phone number and timer remain readable and the caller name does not collide with the avatar or controls.

At font1.3 the Hebrew New call caption is truncated in the emerald six-control normal layout. The phone-plus icon remains clear, and the More panel captures show the full label. Other controls and hang-up remain visible.

scope_limits: All101 reviewed call-design captures are static fictional call-state fixtures rendered by the production in-app call UI. Screenshot appearance does not establish real Telecom call action acknowledgement or actual audible routing.

The review covers the pictured five call designs, light/dark variants, normal/audio/more/keypad states, Hebrew/English long-name cases, font scale1.3 and the English no-Bluetooth output chooser. It does not exhaust every data, font, theme and device combination.
No physical Jelly Star, SIM/carrier, microphone/speaker/Bluetooth audio, lockscreen/proximity, full TalkBack or matching-key data-preserving upgrade was tested by this visual review.

This report covers source2 call visuals only. It is retained as an accurate comparison, not publication approval: the separate changelog review identified an installed-version bidirectional-order defect, which root is fixing before a third complete CI run and fresh full233-image review.
